新闻报道 1.
News Report 1.
一名佛罗里达州的青少年和一名亚特兰大的女子赢得了比赛周六将举行男子和女子组的总决赛一年一度的7英里桥梁长跑。
A Florida teenager and an Atlanta woman won the overall men's and women's divisions Saturday at the annual 7-mile bridge run.
来自佛罗里达州大松岛的15岁青年瓦茨拉夫·布尔萨总成绩第一名。
Václav Bursa, 15, of Big Pine Key, Florida, finished first overall.
他用时41分钟完成了比赛。仅用1秒就夺得了榜首位置男子组。
He completed the race in 41 minutes and 1 second and claimed the top spot in the men's division.
布尔萨在20-22届比赛中获得第三名种族。
Bursa won third place in the 20-22 race.
他是马拉松高中的一名学生。
He is a student at Marathon High School.
来自亚特兰大的28岁乔安娜·史蒂文斯完成了课程耗时41分12秒。
Joanna Stevens, 28, of Atlanta, completed the course in 41 minutes and 12 seconds.
她赢得了女子组冠军，并取得了名次。总成绩第二名。
She won the women's division title and placed second overall.
这项赛事吸引了来自美国41个国家的参赛者。
The race drew competitors from 41 U.S.
各州。
states.
还有其他国家的选手参赛，包括加拿大、英国和瑞士。
There were also runners from other countries, including Canada, the U.K., and Switzerland.
这次跑动缩短了中部之间的距离。下基斯岛交通拥堵持续了三个小时周六。
The run closed the span between the Middle and Lower Keys to traffic for three hours Saturday.
四月份的比赛是其中最……美国东南部地区流行的跑步赛事。
The April contest is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern United States.
在线比赛开始后几分钟内，参赛名额就被填满了。注册于一月份开放。
The race field filled within minutes after online registration opened in January.
新闻报道 2.
News Report 2.
英国宇航员蒂姆·皮克将永久卸任。他曾担任欧洲宇航员。
British astronaut Tim Peake is stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut.
他打算全职工作转而担任科学和太空大使的职位，这是他自 2019 年以来一直在从事的工作。
He's going to take up a full-time position as ambassador for science and space instead, work he's been doing since 2019.
这位前英国陆军航空兵直升机飞行员被选为欧洲航天局宇航员2009年。
The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot was selected as a European Space Agency astronaut in 2009.
他飞往空间站……2015年进行了为期六个月的巡演。
He flew to the space station for a six-month tour in 2015.
在巡演中，他操控了一个机器人从轨道上远程操控地球。
The tour saw him control a robot on Earth remotely from orbit.
他还参与了两艘航天器的对接工作。
He also helped dock two spacecraft.
蒂姆说，当宇航员一直是……非常非凡的经历。
Tim said, Being an astronaut has been the most extraordinary experience.
我有幸与一位过去13年里，我们拥有一支杰出的团队。在该机构工作多年。
I've had the privilege of working with an exceptional team of individuals during the past 13 years with the agency.
这真是令人无比兴奋和收获满满。
It has been incredibly exciting and rewarding.
通过担任大使的角色我将继续支持载人航天飞行。欧洲航天局和英国航天局。
By assuming the role of an ambassador for human flights to space, I'll continue to support the European and the UK space agencies.
通讯3.
News report 3.
威尔士的一家ASDA商店现在是它们闯入后，被送到了五只猫那里。他们放松下来，找了个舒服的地方坐好。
An ASDA store in Wales is now home to five cats after they wandered in and made themselves comfortable.
这家超市以其忠实顾客而闻名。但现在访客类型有所不同了。过去一年中出现的情况。
The supermarket is known for its loyal customers, but now has a different kind of visitor that has appeared over the last year.
经常光顾这家超市的人都很熟悉几只猫安顿下来的景象商店的过道。
Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the sight of several cats settling down in the shop aisles.
这种不寻常的情况大约始于12个月前。当一只猫开始经常光顾这家商店时。
The unusual situation started about 12 months ago, when one cat routinely started visiting the store.
当地报纸报道说，困惑的顾客在社交媒体上发帖求助。通过 Facebook 群组来了解情况猫走丢了。
Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost.
但其所有者向担忧的顾客保证在家备受宠爱和照顾。
But its owner assured the concerned customers it was very much loved and fed at home.
它只是喜欢逛这家店。
It just enjoyed visiting the shop.
工作人员尽力劝阻这只宠物与其闲逛，不如离开，它再也没有回来，于是邀请朋友们来家里玩。
Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around, but instead of leaving and never coming back, it invited its friends round.
现在至少有五只不同的猫他们几乎每天都来。
There are now at least five different cats who come almost on a daily basis.
他们光顾这家店的次数太多了，以至于店员都……被迫竖起标语询问他们的顾客不会喂它们。
They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs asking their customers not to feed them.
